_doc: Community farm spots, researched from public guides (2026-11-17). Facts only (zone, mob/camp, approx. coordinates, target items), notes in own words. Resolved at build time against the Forever spawn data (QuestieDB) and loot tables: `mobs` = case-insensitive name substrings (`exact` = full names), `items` = target items (also used to find mobs if no `mobs` given), `at` + `r` = approximate guide coordinates and radius, `nodes`/`nodeType` = gathering nodes. Entries that do not resolve are reported and skipped. Instances have no spawn coordinates.
